design: A fixed £90,000 fund faces a £300,000 gap. Council tax can't rise, and the leisure centre, library and gritting are the only other money. Every route crosses a red line the town would set: no tax rise, no closure, no cut to winter gritting or care.
tests_hint: Limits: no council tax rise; no closing the leisure centre or library; nobody's gas or electricity cut off. Tests: says who pays and how much; names a date help starts; names who can apply and how.
angles: Spread the £90,000 thinly across all 1,100 homes
Target the poorest 300 homes, fund the rest by savings
Borrow and ask the energy firms for a bill freeze
